meta.defaultTitle: BajGo — Bajaaj rides and deliveries in Garowe
meta.defaultDescription: BajGo is Garowe's on-demand Bajaaj app for rides and deliveries. Book a Bajaaj or send a parcel in a few taps, see your fare before you go, and track your driver live.

footer.socialNote: Social handles are placeholders until the accounts are live.
footer.tagline: Bajaaj rides and deliveries in Garowe.

common.draftBannerTitle: Draft — to be reviewed by counsel
common.draftBannerBody: This text is a first draft and has not yet been reviewed by a lawyer. It may change before launch.
common.placeholderNote: Items in [brackets] are placeholders to be confirmed by BajGo.

fare.title: Fare before you go
fare.intro: Type a distance and see what the trip would cost. In the app the exact fare is shown before you confirm.
fare.localNote: Estimate based on BajGo's published launch rates: $0.50 per km, $1.00 minimum, rounded up to 10 cents. The app shows the exact fare for your route before you confirm.
fare.liveNote: Quote from the BajGo pricing service for a straight-line route of this length. Your in-app fare uses the real road distance.
fare.offlineNote: The pricing service could not be reached, so this is a local estimate.
fare.invalid: Enter a distance between 0.1 and 50 km.

download.comingSoon: Links go live when the apps are published.
download.scanBody: Point your camera at the code to open the download page.

forms.subject: Subject
forms.invalidPhone: Enter a valid Somali number starting with +252.
forms.consent: I agree that BajGo may contact me about this request and store my details as described in the privacy policy.
forms.contactSuccessTitle: Thank you — we received your message.
forms.contactSuccessBody: Our team will reply by phone or email as soon as possible.
forms.localModeBody: The BajGo server is not connected to this website yet, so your submission was stored on this server only. Please also contact us at {email} to make sure we see it.
forms.errorBody: Your submission could not be sent. Please check your connection and try again, or contact us at {email}.

driver.intro: This is a pre-registration. After we receive it, a BajGo team member will call you to arrange document checks in Garowe.
driver.rentBajaaj: Yes, I drive one owned by someone else
driver.hasLicence: I hold a valid driving licence
driver.area: Area of Garowe you usually work in
driver.successBody: Thank you, {name}. We will call {phone} to arrange the next step. Keep your ID, licence and Bajaaj documents ready.

coverage.title: Where BajGo works
coverage.note: The shaded area is the current BajGo service area in Garowe. It will grow as more drivers join.
coverage.placeholder: Initial service area — boundary will be refined before launch.

trip.title: Trip shared with you
trip.notFoundTitle: This trip link is not available.
trip.notFoundBody: The link may have expired, or the trip has ended. Ask the person who shared it to send a new link.
trip.demoNote: Demo trip — sample data shown because no BajGo API is connected.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

pricing.note: Prices are set by BajGo and may change. The exact fare for your trip is always shown in the app before you confirm.
